posts.trend: Can You Rent Your Way Out Of Loneliness? - India Today
posts.context: Explaining the high-priced modern concept of co-living to traditional Indian parents.
posts.angle: Parents see through the expensive terminology of the real estate industry instantly.
slides: "Beta, you pay so much to share a kitchen with strangers?"

"No mummy, it's co-living. There's a community."
"But you don't even talk to our relatives."
"That's different, these are curated young professionals."
"So you pay to have friends?"

"It has a pool table, mummy."

"But you don't know how to play."
posts.caption: Whose mother is this?
posts.rank_verdict: The script format is slightly dialogue-heavy, but the maternal shutdown on the final slide makes it work.
